expiable.definition: s. capable of being atoned for
expiable.translation: a. 可赎的, 可抵偿的

expiate.translation:
vt. 补偿, 赎
vi. 抵偿, 赎罪

expiated.translation: v. <正>为（所犯罪过）接受惩罚, 赎（罪）( expiate的过去式和过去分词 )

expiates.translation: v. <正>为（所犯罪过）接受惩罚, 赎（罪）( expiate的第三人称单数 )

expiating.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Expiate
expiating.translation: v. <正>为（所犯罪过）接受惩罚, 赎（罪）( expiate的现在分词 )

expiation.definition: n. the act of atoning for sin or wrongdoing (especially appeasing a deity)
expiation.translation:
n. 赎罪, 补偿
[法] 偿罪, 赎罪

expiative.definition: a having power to atone for or offered by way of expiation or propitiation

expiator.definition: n. One who makes expiation or atonement.
expiator.translation:
n. 抵罪者, 赎罪者
[法] 赎罪者, 偿罪者

expiatory.definition: a. having power to atone for or offered by way of expiation or propitiation
expiatory.translation: a. 赎罪的, 抵偿的

expiration.definition:
n a coming to an end of a contract period
n euphemistic expressions for death
n the act of expelling air from the lungs
expiration.translation:
n. 终止, 满期, 呼出, 呼气
[医] 呼[气], 断气, 死亡

expiration chug.definition:
when someone drinks milk very quickly on the day of the expiration date
> Person a: what happened to that gallon of milk in the refrigerator?
> Person b: Oh, I gave it an expiration chug, so it wouldn't go bad.
> Person a: Good thinking!

expiration date.translation: [经] 有效期限, 截止日期

expiration dating.translation: 到期约会（到约定时间即终止的约会）

expiration of the imprisonment.translation: [法] 刑期满, 监禁期满

expiratory.definition: a. of or relating to the breathing out phase of respiration
expiratory.translation:
a. 吐气的, 呼气的
[医] 呼[气]的

expire.definition:
v lose validity
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v expel air
expire.translation:
vi. 期满, 呼气, 断气
vt. 呼出

expired.definition: a. having come to an end or become void after passage of a period of time

expiree.translation: n. (旧时由英国放逐至澳大利亚服刑的)服满刑期者,满期出狱者,前科犯

expires.definition:
v lose validity
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v expel air
expires.translation: v. 期满( expire的第三人称单数 ); 文件、协议等（因到期而）失效; 断气; 逝世

expiring.definition:
v lose validity
v pass from physical life and lose all bodily attributes and functions necessary to sustain life
v expel air
expiring.translation: v. 期满( expire的现在分词 ); 文件、协议等（因到期而）失效; 断气; 逝世

expiring date.translation: [经] 到期日, 有效期限

expirt.translation: [法] 期满, 终止, 呼气

expirt date.translation: [法] 期满之日, 失效之日

expiry.definition:
n a coming to an end of a contract period
n the event of dying or departure from life
expiry.translation:
n. 终结, 满期, 呼气, 断气
[经] 满期, 到期

expiry date.translation:
[计] 截止日期
[化] 期满日期; 截止日期

expiscate.definition:
v. t. To fish out; to find out by skill or laborious
   investigation; to search out.
expiscate.translation: vt.<主苏格兰>查出,探明, 搜出

expiscation.definition: n. The act of expiscating; a fishing.

expiscatory.definition: a. Tending to fish out; searching out
